description: Linea zkEVM rollup telemetry from the public Linea RPC: latest sequencer block, safe block and finalized block (proven and finalized on Ethereum L1) with numbers, times and transaction counts, the finality lag in blocks and seconds, gas price (gwei), base fee, gas used % of limit and average block time over the last 20 blocks. Batch/proof IDs are not exposed by the RPC and are not reported. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_arbiscan_l2_rollup when you need Arbitrum One rollup batch postings to Ethereum L1. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_linea_consensys_rollup
title: Linea zkEVM rollup telemetry from the public Linea RPC
